# Simpleworks Consulting

> Independent management consulting firm based in Bengaluru, working with founder-led Indian MSMEs and family businesses (₹10–100 crore revenue) on go-to-market strategy, OKR execution, and business coaching. Led directly by founder Premraj Menon — no junior consultants, no handoffs. Full engagements are in-person in Bengaluru; advisory calls are available remotely.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.simpleworks.in/): Overview of Simpleworks and what the firm does
- [About](https://www.simpleworks.in/about): Premraj Menon's background — 39 years across MRF, Apollo Tyres, BPL Mobile, Bharti Airtel, COO Tata Docomo Kerala Circle, Viworks Ventures, Neoffice.ai
- [Services](https://www.simpleworks.in/services): Full service overview — GTM strategy, OKR execution, business coaching
- [Contact](https://www.simpleworks.in/contact): How to reach Simpleworks, book a first call
